sn45.34:1.2: “Bhikkhus, these eight things, when developed and cultivated, lead to going beyond from the near shore to the far shore.
sn45.34:1.5: These eight things, when developed and cultivated, lead to going beyond from the near shore to the far shore.”
sn45.34:2.1: This is what the Blessed One said.
sn45.34:2.2: Having said this, the Fortunate One, the Teacher, further said this:
sn45.34:3.2: Who go beyond to the far shore.
sn45.34:3.3: The rest of the people merely run
sn45.34:3.4: Up and down along the bank.
sn45.34:4.2: Those who practise in accord with the Dhamma
sn45.34:4.3: Are the people who will go beyond
sn45.34:4.4: The realm of Death so hard to cross.
sn45.34:5.2: The wise man should develop the bright ones.
sn45.34:5.3: Having come from home into homelessness,
sn45.34:5.4: Where it is hard to take delight—
sn45.34:6.1: “There in seclusion he should seek delight,
sn45.34:6.4: Should cleanse himself of mental defilements.
sn45.34:7.5: Those luminous ones with taints destroyed
sn45.34:7.6: Are fully quenched in the world.”
